import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.PartialFractions
import Mathlib.FieldTheory.IsAlgClosed.Basic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

/-!
# Partial fractions over an algebraically closed field

Every element of the fraction field of `k[X]` is a polynomial plus finitely many
scalar multiples of negative powers of linear factors. The denominator and pole
coefficients are produced from the element itself. This is the algebraic
decomposition needed for the rational differential residue theorem on `P1`;
identification with scheme points and intrinsic residues is a separate step.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v

open Polynomial

namespace Hartshorne
namespace RationalPartialFractions

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {K : Type v} [Field K] [Algebra k[X] K] [IsFractionRing k[X] K]

/-- Partial fractions with linear denominators have scalar numerators. -/
theorem exists_eq_polynomial_add_sum_of_linear_denominator
    (p : k[X]) (s : Finset k) (n : k → ℕ) :
    ∃ (q : k[X]) (c : (a : k) → Fin (n a) → k),
      algebraMap k[X] K p *
          ∏ a ∈ s, (algebraMap k[X] K (X - C a))⁻¹ ^ n a =
        algebraMap k[X] K q + ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ j : Fin (n a),
          algebraMap k[X] K (C (c a j)) *
            (algebraMap k[X] K (X - C a))⁻¹ ^ (j.val + 1) := by
  classical
  have hinj := IsFractionRing.injective k[X] K
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, heq⟩ :=
    Polynomial.mul_prod_pow_inverse_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_inverse
      (K := K) (s := s) p (fun a _ => monic_X_sub_C a)
      (fun a _ b _ hab => pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C Function.injective_id hab) n
      (gi := fun a => (algebraMap k[X] K (X - C a))⁻¹)
      (fun a _ => inv_mul_cancel₀ (by simpa using hinj.ne (X_sub_C_ne_zero a)))
  refine ⟨q, fun a j => (r a j).eval a, heq.trans ?_⟩
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro j
  have hc : r a j = C ((r a j).eval a) := by
    exact ((modByMonic_eq_self_iff (monic_X_sub_C a)).mpr (hr a ha j)).symm.trans
      (modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval (r a j) a)
  rw [hc]

variable [IsAlgClosed k]

/-- An arbitrary rational function has a finite partial-fraction expansion,
with scalar coefficients at each positive pole order. -/
theorem exists_eq_polynomial_add_sum_inv_pow (f : K) :
    ∃ (q : k[X]) (s : Finset k) (n : k → ℕ) (c : (a : k) → Fin (n a) → k),
      f = algebraMap k[X] K q + ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ j : Fin (n a),
        algebraMap k[X] K (C (c a j)) *
          (algebraMap k[X] K (X - C a))⁻¹ ^ (j.val + 1) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, d, _, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective k[X] f
  have hd : d = C d.leadingCoeff *
      ∏ a ∈ d.roots.toFinset, (X - C a) ^ rootMultiplicity a d := by
    rw [← prod_multiset_root_eq_finset_root]
    exact (IsAlgClosed.splits d).eq_prod_roots
  have hC : algebraMap k[X] K (C d.leadingCoeff⁻¹) =
      (algebraMap k[X] K (C d.leadingCoeff))⁻¹ :=
    map_inv₀ ((algebraMap k[X] K).comp C) d.leadingCoeff
  obtain ⟨q, c, heq⟩ := exists_eq_polynomial_add_sum_of_linear_denominator
    (K := K) (C d.leadingCoeff⁻¹ * p) d.roots.toFinset (fun a => rootMultiplicity a d)
  refine ⟨q, d.roots.toFinset, fun a => rootMultiplicity a d, c, ?_⟩
  rw [← heq, map_mul, hC]
  conv_lhs => rw [hd]
  simp only [map_mul, map_prod, map_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv,
    Finset.prod_inv_distrib, inv_pow]
  ac_rfl

end
end RationalPartialFractions
end Hartshorne
